assignment_schedule_check.name: assignment_schedule_check
assignment_schedule_check.value:
("assignment"."available_at" is null or "assignment"."due_at" is null or "assignment"."available_at" <= "assignment"."due_at")
        and ("assignment"."due_at" is null or "assignment"."closes_at" is null or "assignment"."due_at" <= "assignment"."closes_at")

learning_resource_payload_check.name: learning_resource_payload_check
learning_resource_payload_check.value:
("learning_resource"."type" = 'text' and "learning_resource"."content" is not null and "learning_resource"."url" is null
          and "learning_resource"."file_key" is null and "learning_resource"."file_name" is null and "learning_resource"."file_size" is null)
        or ("learning_resource"."type" in ('link', 'file') and "learning_resource"."url" is not null
          and "learning_resource"."file_key" is null and "learning_resource"."file_name" is null and "learning_resource"."file_size" is null)
        or ("learning_resource"."type" = 'file' and "learning_resource"."url" is null
          and "learning_resource"."file_key" is not null and "learning_resource"."file_name" is not null
          and "learning_resource"."file_size" is not null and "learning_resource"."file_size" > 0)

quiz_schedule_check.name: quiz_schedule_check
quiz_schedule_check.value:
("quiz"."available_at" is null or "quiz"."due_at" is null or "quiz"."available_at" <= "quiz"."due_at")
        and ("quiz"."due_at" is null or "quiz"."closes_at" is null or "quiz"."due_at" <= "quiz"."closes_at")

quiz_answer_value_check.name: quiz_answer_value_check
quiz_answer_value_check.value:
("quiz_answer"."selected_option_id" is not null and "quiz_answer"."text_answer" is null)
        or ("quiz_answer"."selected_option_id" is null and nullif(btrim("quiz_answer"."text_answer"), '') is not null)

tutor_message_metadata_check.name: tutor_message_metadata_check
tutor_message_metadata_check.value:
("tutor_message"."author" = 'student' and "tutor_message"."mode" is not null and "tutor_message"."model_version" is null)
        or ("tutor_message"."author" = 'tutor' and "tutor_message"."mode" is not null and "tutor_message"."model_version" is not null)
        or ("tutor_message"."author" = 'system' and "tutor_message"."mode" is null and "tutor_message"."model_version" is null)
